column1: # Reviewed, explained shadow diffs (applied by target/review/exec/shadow_report.py; never by the oracle itself).

column5: [regs: return registers whose diff is explained, e.g. xmm0]

column4: x86 copies 16 B from [rsp+0x60] into job+0x18 incl. 4 B of uninitialised stack padding at job+0x22 (mov eax,[rsp+0x3a]; mov [rsp+0x6a],eax); Rust writes extra_id as u64 (zeros). Consumers read the u16 only.

x86 never writes xmm0 (returns a pointer in rax); xmm0 at ret is whatever callees (host imports via IAT) left: G 0, N the incoming 1.0f. Only caller 142238694 does not read xmm0; 14223c4e0 just forwards.
